from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

def analyze(img_path):
    arr = np.array(Image.open(img_path))
    # Plant green:
    green_mask = (arr[:, :, 1] > 90) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 50) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 50)
    # Plant pot terracotta:
    pot_mask = (arr[:, :, 0] > 140) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 190) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 60) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 50)
    # Lamp shade:
    lamp_shade = (arr[:, :, 0] > 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 170) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 160)
    # Lamp base:
    lamp_base = (arr[:, :, 0] > 60) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 90) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 70) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 100) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 80) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 120)
    # Stool top:
    stool_top = (arr[:, :, 0] > 120) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 160) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 50) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 90) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 40)
    # Table top (brown):
    table_top = (arr[:, :, 0] > 130) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 180) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 70) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 110) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 50)
    
    res = {}
    for name, m in [("green", green_mask), ("pot", pot_mask), ("lamp_shade", lamp_shade), ("lamp_base", lamp_base), ("stool_top", stool_top)]:
        y, x = np.where(m)
        if len(x) > 10:
            res[name] = (float(x.mean()), float(y.mean()), int(x.min()), int(x.max()), int(y.min()), int(y.max()))
    return res

for f in ["obs_0001", "obs_0008", "obs_0017", "obs_0018", "obs_0019", "obs_0020"]:
    print(f, analyze(f"/work/observations/{f}.png"))
'", "description": "Analyze object masks in several observations"}

{"command": "python3 -c "
import math, json

with open('/work/history.jsonl') as f:
    history = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

x, y, heading = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
poses = {1: (x, y, heading)}
for entry in history[1:]:
    f_id = entry['frame']
    act = entry['requested_action']
    heading = (heading + act['turn_deg']) % 360.0
    rad = math.radians(heading)
    x += act['move_m'] * math.sin(rad)
    y += act['move_m'] * math.cos(rad)
    poses[f_id] = (x, y, heading)

print('Pose at frame 102:', poses[102])
print('Pose at frame 103:', poses[103])
print('Pose at frame 104:', poses[104])
"", "description": "Check poses for frames 102-104"}
